subject.title: Dashboard: apps layer — full-bleed tabs + widget gallery

question: Should OpenClaw accept a default-on bundled dashboard app/gallery surface that installs third-party widget bundles, and under what storage and dependency-approval boundary should it land?
rationale: The PR changes default startup behavior, dependency graph, persisted runtime state, and browser sandbox trust boundaries; automation cannot choose the product/security boundary or grant dependency approval.

options.title: Pause and narrow after the base stack
options.body: Wait for #101098 and the dashboard storage/security decisions, then rebase this PR to the full-bleed/gallery delta with dependency approval or removal.

options.title: Accept the bundled surface with explicit exceptions
options.body: Maintainers can approve the dependency graph, JSON state exception, and default-on dashboard security model, then require targeted bug fixes and proof before merge.

options.title: Move gallery/app install out of bundled core
options.body: Keep only generic dashboard seams in OpenClaw and route third-party widget discovery/install behavior to ClawHub or an external plugin surface.

recommendation.title: Pause and narrow after the base stack
recommendation.body: Wait for #101098 and the dashboard storage/security decisions, then rebase this PR to the full-bleed/gallery delta with dependency approval or removal.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current dashboard app-layer proposal and can produce the narrow rebased branch, while final approval still needs maintainer/security review.
